result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may assign without consent to affiliates and qualifying successors, while IBM requires Customer consent, may never assign to a Customer competitor, and receives no termination right upon Customer change of control. The redline preserves unrelated commercial intent and is professionally drafted. However, changing the continuing-liability provision from Customer-only to both assigning parties adds a substantive protection not required by the playbook, so the revision is not strictly minimal.
